title: Azure OpenAI with a Mistral fallback
prompt: Create src/lib/summarize.ts for use outside the Inferlo app. Without createApp, use Inferlo's standalone AI module to create an AI client and export it as `ai`. It has two providers: Azure OpenAI on the resource "contoso-eu" with the API key from the AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable, named "azure", and Mistral with the API key from MISTRAL_API_KEY, named "mistral". The "fast" alias uses the Azure deployment "gpt-5-mini-prod" and falls back to mistral-small-latest when Azure fails. Also export `async function summarize(text: string, userId: string)` that returns a one-sentence summary of the text from the "fast" model, tracking usage for userId.
